title: mcp: validate_expression at flow_condition judges a bare name without the flow's variables, so its type verdict and the door's shadowed-read warning can differ from the runtime flow door
body:
domain:server#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzuZJBQY4wUQFJbkfx

Filing gate: ① a named-site behaviour gap, class a. It is carried out of #33147 (PR #33168): the seat's contract review 6868101966 lists it as outside that PR's diff, together with its finding F1. PR #33168 corrects the wording and says the tool cannot give these verdicts. ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the lane and grade.
reach: public door, and a verdict that differs from the gate. MCP `validate_expression` (`/api/v1/mcp` `tools/call`, and stdio) at `site: 'flow_condition'`. Read at PR #33168 head `c21d260c`; not measured on a running deployment.

## Business reason

An agent writes a flow whose variables include one named like a field, for example `amount`, and reads it bare in a condition. The runtime flow door warns about the shadowed read (`warnShadowedFieldReads`), and it types the bare name as the variable. `validate_expression` gets no variables. It types the bare name as the field, and it cannot give the warning. So the agent can be told `ok`, or be given a type verdict for the wrong binding, and then meet a different answer when it saves the flow.

## What is true after PR #33168

- `flow_condition` runs the runtime flow door's passes on a one-flow probe. The probe flow declares no variables, so `warnShadowedFieldReads` has nothing to compare against.
- The tool's validator half (the shared expression validator) is never handed flow variables, so a bare name resolves against the object's fields only.

## Expected

`validate_expression` at `flow_condition` takes the flow's declared variables, as an optional input or read from a named served flow. With them it binds bare names the way the door does, and it gives the door's shadowed-read warning. When no variables are given, it answers as today, and the description says so. The implementer proposes the input shape.

Dedupe: `validate_expression flow variables shadowed field read warnShadowedFieldReads` → #33147 (PR #33168, flow_condition parity, wording only for this point); none open.
